enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing face, brushing teeth and using the toilet
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on bathroom light. Lift toilet lid. Urinate. Flush toilet. Lower toilet lid. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub hands together. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth with water. Spit into sink. Turn on tap. Rinse toothbrush. Turn off tap. Put toothbrush back. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Hang towel. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with the kettle and toaster
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and butter. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bread. Place bread slices in toaster. Press toaster lever down. Fill kettle with water. Plug in kettle. Turn on kettle. Wait for kettle to boil. Kettle boils. Pour hot water into mug. Add tea bag. Wait for toaster. Toast pops up. Remove toast from toaster. Place toast on plate. Spread butter on toast. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink tea. Finish meal. Stand up. Clear plate and mug. Place in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing work bag for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Put on shirt. Take out pants. Put on pants. Take out socks. Put on socks. Take out shoes. Put on shoes. Walk to desk. Pick up work bag. Open work bag. Pick up laptop. Place laptop in bag. Pick up notebook. Place notebook in bag. Pick up pen. Place pen in bag. Pick up phone. Place phone in bag. Close work bag. Pick up keys. Place keys in pocket. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk out of house. Lock front door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to bus door. Exit bus. Walk to office building. Enter building. Walk to elevator. Press elevator button. Wait for elevator. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to office door. Open office door. Enter office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: coordinating community program logistics and checking emails
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email application. Check new emails. Read email. Reply to email. Open calendar. Check schedule. Make phone call to community partner. Discuss program logistics. Take notes. Hang up. Open document. Edit program plan. Print document. Walk to printer. Pick up printout. Walk back to desk. Open spreadsheet. Update budget. Save file. Stand up. Walk to meeting room. Attend meeting. Discuss program coordination. Return to desk. Check emails again.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating lunch near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from desk. Walk out of office. Walk to nearby cafe. Enter cafe. Stand in line. Order sandwich. Pay cashier. Receive sandwich. Walk to table. Sit down. Unwrap sandwich. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Finish meal. Stand up. Throw away trash. Walk out of cafe. Walk back to office. Enter office. Walk to desk. Sit down.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: meeting community partners and preparing program materials
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from desk. Walk to meeting room. Greet community partner. Shake hands. Sit at table. Discuss program details. Take notes. Present program materials. Answer questions. Stand up. Shake hands. Walk partner to exit. Return to desk. Open computer. Create program flyer. Design layout. Add text. Add images. Save flyer. Print flyer. Walk to printer. Pick up flyers. Walk back to desk. Staple flyers. Organize materials. Place in folder. Check emails. Reply to email.

Stand up from desk. Pack bag. Walk out of office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to bus door. Exit bus. Walk to home. Unlock front door. Enter home. Close door. Lock door. Walk to bedroom. Put down bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner using the induction cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and chicken. Close refrigerator. Walk to sink. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables on cutting board. Place pan on induction cooker. Plug in induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Pour oil into pan. Add chopped vegetables. Stir with spatula. Add chicken. Stir. Add salt and soy sauce. Cover pan. Cook for 10 minutes. Turn off induction cooker. Uncover pan. Transfer food to plate. Walk to dining table. Sit down. Eat dinner. Drink water. Finish eating. Stand up. Pick up plate and utensils. Walk to sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up plates from table. Scrape food scraps into trash can. Rinse plates under tap. Open dishwasher door. Place plates in dishwasher rack. Place utensils in basket. Add detergent to dispenser. Close dishwasher door. Press start button. Pick up cloth. Wipe dining table. Wipe kitchen counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote control. Press power button on TV. TV turns on. Press channel button. Change to news channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume with remote. Put remote on sofa. Lean back. Watch TV. Change channel again. Watch movie. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer and desk lamp to draft program schedules for the next workday
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for computer to start. Enter password. Open calendar application. Create new event. Type program schedule. Add times. Add locations. Save event. Open document. Draft schedule details. Type notes. Save document. Close laptop. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Wait for water to heat. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Undress. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse body. Apply shampoo. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Walk to bedroom. Put on pajamas.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch TV. Change channel. Watch show. Adjust volume. Put remote down. Lean back. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Pour glass of water. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Drink water. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting out clothes for tomorrow and turning on the fan
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Lay shirt on chair. Take out pants. Lay pants on chair. Take out socks. Lay socks on chair. Walk to fan. Press power button. Adjust fan speed. Walk to bed. Pull back blanket. Lie down.
Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep.
